method: Contact sheets of all 475 clothing and outfit crops, plus full-resolution review of three style entries sharing the original clothing board; full-resolution and pixel-divider review of nine originals; visual reinspection of all 138 corrected crops. This is an AI-assisted material review, not professional patternmaking or all-library certification.

issues.finding: 等分行高未贴合原图格线，部分礼服混入下一格编号或头顶，末行风格图的帽顶被截掉。
issues.resolution: 核对全分辨率原图并测量实际格线；双边框取留白中心，重新检查全部修正后切图。
